**Meridian Tidal Pilot - Summary**

The main equipment failure was Turbine T-4 taking offline on 14 March 2025 due to a corroded bearing seal allowing seawater into the nacelle, with root cause traced to corrosion of the bearing seal housing. Titanium fasteners were replaced by duplex stainless steel per lead engineer Dr. Ines Marchetti's recommendation, accepted in principle by the steering group.

Total energy delivered was 18.7 GWh over 24 months, 6% below the 19.9 GWh forecast. The project cost EUR 41.25 million against a budget of EUR 36.7 million—a EUR 4.55M overrun (12.4%), driven mainly by the T-4 repair campaign.

The independent fish-monitoring programme found no statistically significant change in fish migration counts before and after installation (p = 0.41).

The steering group approved Phase 2 for Q3 2026, contingent on a completed bearing seal redesign and a successful dry-dock endurance test.
